message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: a public official (林某甲) used his position to accept bribes (money) in exchange for influencing procurement bidding. This is classic "受贿" (accepting bribes) under the crime of bribery (受贿罪). Also possibly "行贿" is not his act. He also disclosed tender information to a company for a fee: also bribery. So the crime is "受贿罪". Could there be "滥用职权" (abuse of power) but the main is bribery. Also "徇私舞弊" maybe but not typical. The law: "国家工作人员利用职务上的便利，索取他人财物或者非法收受他人财物，为他人谋取利益的行为" is受贿罪. He also "泄露国家秘密"? No. So only one crime: 受贿罪.

Thus answer: [罪名]受贿罪<eoa>
